summary.plain: The Frascati and Rome group that ran the Gamma-Gamma experiments at ADONE, first generation and, as Gamma-Gamma 2, second generation.
summary.technical: Gamma-Gamma Group: researchers from Frascati and Rome (INFN-LNF page); the group signs the 1974 Phys. Rev. Lett. 33, 1408 paper as 'The Gamma-Gamma Group, Laboratori Nazionali di Frascati'. Membership list not retrieved.
